phase_name: Redeploy, Full Verification, and the Operator Handoff

objectives.description: Redeploy with the bounded-wait idiom; treat exit 3/4 as distinct from exit 0
Confirm the deploy landed the three new files
Run the new suite from the deployed tree and the source store
Run the scoped touched-path check over every path this task touched; record the full gate set deferred to orchestration close
Dry read-through of /slice's resolution and prompt-1 arithmetic against this repository's live difference
Record the exact operator lines in the handoff and final return; state the record is not closed
Do not mark the task complete, do not push, do not invoke a forge CLI, do not create a pull request

deviations.reason: This is a genuine defect this task's own new test file introduced (not foreign drift), caught by the deploy's own inline fast-gate verification exactly as that gate is designed to catch it. Fixed forward per the Write-Gating Constraint (never discard uncommitted work to reach a passing build) rather than suppressing or skipping the gate.
